notes: v1.10.4 - Triggers: a "Repeat on line" setting fires a regex trigger once for every match on the line, each with its own wildcards (MUSHclient's "repeat on same line" now imports). Fixed a crash when a trigger was put in a group and another trigger in that group was then clicked. Click-to-focus: raising the window (title bar, taskbar, alt-tab) and the "back to bottom" chip now hand the keyboard to the command line, and the command line is focused with its text selected, so "keep the last command" works after a click too. Settings: the Connection, Appearance and Plugins tabs scroll when the window is too short. New plugin: 3S Changeling, the Changeling guild HUD (protoplasm, stamina, super, abilities, instincts, form, record; 'clhud'). Farmer 1.6.0: the kill log switches between this session and all time.
